source_text: Si feminam pepererit, bis numeri. Infirmitior affectus longiorem curam poscit. Misericordia tempora adaptat.
pass_a_gloss: If female she-will-have-borne, twice of-numbers. Weaker affection longer care demands. Mercy times adapts.
pass_b_english: If she bears a [[female, the days are doubled >> Bible:Leviticus 12:5]]. The weaker affection asks longer care. Mercy fits the times.
